user.title: Xplora account
user.description: Sign in with the same account you use in the Xplora app. Use either email or phone number.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check your credentials (the app key may also have been rotated).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Xplora service.
error.need_email_or_phone: Provide either an email or a phone number.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to poll (minutes). Kept deliberately slow to avoid Xplora's rate-limiting/IP ban; battery does not need fast polling.
